description: Top organic search keywords a domain ranks for (Semrush type=domain_organic). Returns parsed rows with columns: Ph (keyword phrase), Po (current position), Pp (previous position), Nq (search volume), Cp (CPC), Ur (ranking URL), Tr (traffic %), Co (competition), Nr (number of results). Consumes your Semrush API units.

_apiKey.description: Your own Semrush API key (BYO). Passed to Semrush as the `key` query param. Consumes your Semrush API units.

database.description: 2-letter Semrush regional database (e.g. us, uk, de, fr, es, ca, au). Default us.

display_limit.description: Max keywords to return (default Semrush 10000; pass a small value like 50).

name: domain_organic_keywords
title: Domain Organic Keywords
